title: Team infrastructure declaration (v1)
description: One file per team per environment: teams/<team>/<env>.yaml. The team and environment come from the file path, never from this file.

schema_version.description: Version of this file format. Always 1 for now.

owner.description: Who owns these resources. Used for cost-allocation and ownership tags.

github_team.description: GitHub team that owns this folder (must match the CODEOWNERS line), e.g. my-org/payments.

contact.description: Team Slack channel or alias. No personal emails.

cost_center.description: Finance cost center, copied to the platform:cost-center tag.

workload.description: Kubernetes workload allowed to use the team role via EKS Pod Identity.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace. Must be <team> or start with <team>-.

service_account.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount name in that namespace.

lifecycle.description: Set to decommission to start offboarding the whole team (step 1 of 2). See README.md, 'Flows'.

buckets.description: S3 buckets for this team. The list length is how many buckets you get (1-20).

name.description: Short bucket name, unique in this file. The real bucket is <env>-<team>-<name>.

visibility.description: REQUIRED, no default. private: only your team role. public: anyone on the internet can read objects (requires public.mode and public.justification).

mode.description: cloudfront (recommended): private bucket served through CloudFront. direct: anonymous read of the S3 bucket itself (prod needs platform approval).

justification.description: Why this data may be public. Shown to reviewers.

lifecycle.description: Set to decommission to start safely deleting this bucket (step 1 of 2). See README.md, 'Flows'.
